user.title: Strumok station
user.description: Connect a Strumok EV charging station on your local network. Stations are usually found automatically — check Discovered on the Devices & services page first.

data_description.host: Local IP address or hostname of the station, the same address where its web panel opens (e.g. 192.168.1.57). Port 80 is used automatically.
data_description.api_key: Optional. Needed to control charging from Home Assistant, and to read data if reading without sign-in is closed on the station. Create a key for Home Assistant in the station web panel (Station protection → API keys); it starts with sk_.

discovery_confirm.title: Strumok station found
discovery_confirm.description: Add station {name} ({host}) to Home Assistant? Leave the API key empty to get sensors only; with a key you can also control charging.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Needed to control charging from Home Assistant, and to read data if reading without sign-in is closed on the station. Create a key for Home Assistant in the station web panel (Station protection → API keys); it starts with sk_.

reauth_confirm.title: Station rejected the API key
reauth_confirm.description: Station {name} ({host}) answered 401: sign-in is enabled and the key is missing, revoked or wrong. Create a new key for Home Assistant in the station web panel (Station protection → API keys) and paste it here.

data_description.api_key: The key starts with sk_ and is shown only once, when it is created.

reconfigure.title: Change station {name}
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the API key. Leave the key empty to keep the current one.

data_description.host: Local IP address or hostname of the station, the same address where its web panel opens (e.g. 192.168.1.57). Port 80 is used automatically.
data_description.api_key: Optional. Needed to control charging from Home Assistant, and to read data if reading without sign-in is closed on the station. Create a key for Home Assistant in the station web panel (Station protection → API keys); it starts with sk_.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the station at this address. Check the IP and that the station is on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: The station rejected this API key. Check it or create a new one in the station web panel.
error.auth_required: Reading without sign-in is closed on this station — enter an API key.
error.invalid_key_format: A station API key starts with sk_.
error.not_strumok: A device answers at this address, but it is not a Strumok station.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This station is already added. Its address has been updated if it changed.
abort.already_in_progress: This station is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the discovered station.
abort.not_strumok: The discovered device is not a Strumok station.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: A different station answers at this address. Add it as a new integration instead.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often Home Assistant reads the station. Applies immediately, no restart needed.

data_description.scan_interval: From 5 to 300 seconds; 15 by default. The station has little memory — do not poll more often than you need.

auth_failed.message: The station rejected the request (401). Enter a valid API key.

update_failed.message: Could not read the station at {host}: {error}

command_auth_failed.message: The station rejected the API key. Re-authentication has been started — enter a new key in Devices & services.

command_conflict.message: The station cannot run the command now: {message}

command_unsupported.message: This station firmware does not accept local commands. Update the firmware.

command_failed.message: The station did not accept the command: {message}
